correctness.rationale: PASS: IID scaled exponential spacings yield Dirichlet(1,...,1) shares Z_j. Express G_n=Σ((j-1)/n) Z_j and the top-k share as Σmin(1,k/(n-j+1)) Z_j. Dirichlet covariance gives k[(n+1)(H_n-H_k)-(n-k)]/[2n²(n+1)]; positivity follows strict rearrangement for k<n. Subtraction yields Δ=(n+1)(H_n-H_k)-2(n-k), single sign switch by Δ(k+1)-Δ(k)=2-(n+1)/(k+1), with equality producing exactly a two-way tie. Harmonic asymptotics locate alpha*= -W0(-2e^-2)/2 and limit alpha*(1-alpha*)/2. Rates and all n≥2 boundary conditions consistent.

evidence: Dirichlet moments determine any two linear statistics in normalized spacings; population exponential Lorenz results concern the limit of one marginal curve.
